53:1.text: By the star when it goes down

53:2.text: has neither gone astray nor has erred.

53:4.text: It is only a Revelation revealed.

53:6.text: One free from any defect in body and mind then he
(Jibrîl - Gabriel in his real shape as created by Allah)

53:7.text: was in the highest part of the horizon,

53:9.text: And was at a distance of two bows’ length or

53:10.text: [Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel) عليه السلام]

53:11.text: heart lied not in what he

53:12.text: Will you then dispute with him
[during the Mi‘râj: (Ascent of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم to the seven heavens)]

53:14.text: (a lote-tree of the utmost boundary over the seventh heaven beyond which none can pass)

53:15.text: Near it is the Paradise of Abode.

53:16.text: When that covered the lote-tree which did cover it!

53:17.text: (of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
, nor it transgressed beyond the limit

53:18.text: did see of the Greatest Signs, of his Lord

53:19.text: Have you then considered Al-Lât, and Al-‘Uzzâ

53:21.text: Is it for you the males and for Him the females?

53:22.text: That indeed is a division most unfair!

53:23.text: They are but names which you have named - you and your fathers - for which Allâh has sent down no authority. They follow but a guess and that which they themselves desire, whereas there has surely come to them the Guidance from their Lord!

53:24.text: Or shall man have what he wishes?

53:25.text: But to Allâh belongs the last

53:26.text: And there are many angels in the heavens, whose intercession will avail nothing except after Allâh has given leave for whom He wills and is pleased with.
